title: The check
logline: Monday. The first banner check. $800. Wood, two-thirds size, holds it like a sail. The dog, full size, is not impressed by paper. The strip lets the check be bigger than the man.

panels.composition: The garage. An envelope. WOOD, two-thirds, opening it. BARNABY, normal.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small man opening an envelope in a garage studio while a normal-sized dog watches

panels.composition: The check: $800.00. In his small hands it's a poster.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a small man holding up a check that is nearly as large as his torso
image.notes: Letter after: $800.00. Memo: reserved (the ringtone company's name is never drawn).

panels.composition: Wood holding it up to the window. The light through it. The dog looking at the dog bed instead.

characters.pose: holding the check to the light

balloons.text: This is three rents and a tank of gas and a — a plush.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small man holding a large check up to a window's light while a dog looks away at its bed

panels.composition: The check on the corkboard, pinned, over the eviction notice. Covering it exactly. The small man stepping back. The 2000 offcut's gesture, repeated.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small man stepping back from a corkboard where a check has been pinned precisely over an eviction notice, no words
image.notes: Rhymes with dw_2000-04-20: paper pinned over paper.

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: $800, held like a sail. Pinned over the notice.
